title: AoPS Wiki
text:
The AoPS Wiki project is administered by the Art of Problem Solving for supporting educational content useful to avid math students. It includes many past test questions from the AMC and solutions made by many different users who attempt to contribute to your extracurricular math studies. It also includes information about other math contests as well, from other international countries. The AoPS Wiki is an excellent to prepare for the AMC 8, 10, 12, USMTS, AIME, USAJMO, and USAMO exams, with an extensive coverage of thousands of problems from various math competitions.

In addition to problems from past math contests, it acts like a dictionary for math terms. Definitions, theorems, examples, and more can be found on here with links for helpful practice. Users can contribute to the AoPS Wiki by writing articles or editing/correcting mistakes.

There are also external information that doesn't necessarily relate to math. Recently, there have been more articles covering subjects that range beyond math such as physics, biology, history, etc.
